insight.name: Excepciones en producción
insight.query: SELECT count() AS errores FROM events WHERE event = '$exception' AND properties.app_env = 'production' AND {filters}

insight.name: Alertas de operación
insight.query: SELECT count() AS alertas FROM events WHERE event = 'ops_alert' AND properties.app_env = 'production' AND {filters}

insight.name: LCP p75 en producción
insight.query: SELECT quantile(0.75)(toFloat(properties.$web_vitals_LCP_value)) AS lcp_p75 FROM events WHERE event = '$web_vitals' AND properties.app_env = 'production' AND {filters}
